[[Cold Storage]] }} '''Cold Storage Battle''' (Japanese: '''VSキュレムI''' ''VS Kyurem I''), titled '''VS Kyurem I''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 536th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 12th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Kyurem I''' (Japanese: '''コンテナ・バトル''' ''Container Battle'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Cold Storage Battle''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Zinzolin]] reveals he managed to capture {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} two years ago. * [[Colress]] tells Zinzolin to give him {{p|Kyurem}}, but Zinzolin refuses. * {{adv|Whitley}} drives off the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s and proceeds to call her mother. * {{adv|Looker}} attempts to get [[Hugh]] to explain his connection to [[Team Plasma]], but Hugh refuses and runs off. * {{adv|Blake}} successfully arrests [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]], but soon feels a chill in the air. * Blake is revealed to have added {{TP|Blake|Genesect}} to his team. * Blake has Looker take care of Bronius and Ryoku while he sets off on {{p|Genesect}} to the [[Relic Passage]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} (flashback) * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|Cheren}} (flashback) * [[Iris]] (flashback) * [[Roxie]] * [[Marlon]] (flashback) * [[Colress]] * [[Ghetsis]] (fantasy) * [[Hugh]] * [[Zinzolin]] * [[Gorm]] (fantasy) * [[Rood]] (fantasy) * [[Bronius]] * [[Ryoku]] * [[Giallo]] (fantasy) * [[Leo]] (flashback) * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Genesect}} ({{OP|Blake|Genesect}}) * {{p|Keldeo}} ([[Kelden]];
